test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 63

questions.question: A dishonest milkman professes to sell his milk at cost price; however, he mixes it with water, thus making a profit of 20%. What is the percentage of water in the mixture (rounded off to 2 decimal places)?
A and B working together can do a piece of work in 21 days. B alone can do the same work in 24 days. How long (in days) will A alone take to do the same work?

The marked price of a watch was ₹2,800. Aman bought the watch for ₹2,000, after getting two successive rates of discount, the first of which was 20%. What was the rate of the second discount? (Round off your answer to two decimal places.)
A man walks from point X to Y at a speed of 40 km/hr but comes back from point Y to X at a speed of 50 km/hr. Find his average speed (in km/hr, correct to two decimal places).

A sum of ₹73,300 is deposited at an interest rate of 7% per annum for 2 years. What is the difference (rounded off to one decimal place) between the compound interest (compounded annually) and the simple interest for the same period?
The average of three numbers is 20. If two numbers are 14 and 26, the third number is:
A certain number is divided into two parts, such that 5 times the first part added to 13 times the second part makes 7 times the whole. The ratio of the first part to the second part is _______.
A can run 30 m in 8 seconds and B can run the same distance in 12 seconds. By what distance can A beat B?
The average weight of Shivam, Rupesh and Mandar is 45 kg. If the average weight of Shivam and Rupesh is 38 kg and that of Rupesh and Mandar is 49 kg, then the weight of Rupesh (in kg) is:
What will be the compound interest, compounded annually on a sum of ₹55,000 after 2 years at the rate of 12% per annum?

An unfair shopkeeper claims that he is selling sugar at the rate of ₹38 per kg, which costs him ₹40 per kg, but he uses a 400 g weight instead of a 500 g weight. What is his percentage profit or loss (rounded off to the nearest whole number)?
A shopkeeper sold a book at a loss of 6%. If the selling price had been increased by ₹120, there would have been a gain of 18%. What was the cost price (in ₹) of the book?
A train, 300 m long, is running at a speed of 72 km/hr. How long (in seconds) will it take to cross a platform that is 300 m long?
The simple interest on a sum is ₹478 for a period of 5 years at the rate of 2% per annum. The sum (in ₹) is:
The LCM of 56, 90, 360 and 140 is:
After a reduction of 50% in the original price, the price of an article was ₹1,068. The original price (in ₹) of the article was:

A, B, and C started a business by investing ₹20,000, ₹28,000 and ₹36,000, respectively. After 6 months, A and B withdrew an amount of ₹8,000 each and C invested an additional amount of ₹8,000. All of them invested for an equal period of time. If at the end of the year, C got ₹12,575 as his share of profit, then what was the total profit earned?
The current population of a town is 1,20,000. It has been increasing at a rate of 25% per annum for the past 10 years. What was the difference in the population between 3 years ago and 2 years ago?
At the beginning of a year, the population of a city was 3,54,986. During the year, it increased by 68,471. What was the population of the city at the end of the year?
A bus is moving at a speed of 59 km/hr. If its speed is reduced by 89%, the new speed of the bus (in km/hr) will be:
